title: The helpline number
hook: 1 app away from emptying Mum's account
next: Phone stolen. 3 bank apps on it.

beats.say: Mum found her bank helpline online. The man says install an app.
Found the official number! I also sent it to Mum!
I'm so sorry. Tell her to hang up. The real number is on her card.

screen.title: Fake bank helpline?
screen.body:
1. Hang up.
2. Turn the card over. Call that number.
3. A bank never asks you to install an app or share your screen.
4. Money gone? Call 1930 or go to cybercrime.gov.in

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Card ke peeche wala number lagaya.
Bank bola humne koi call nahi kiya.
Bhaiya ka phone ab band hai.

beats.say: She saved the card number as Real Bank.
beats.show: She saved the card number as REAL BANK.

caption:
mum called the top search result for her bank. the man on the line wanted her to install one app.

the real helpline is printed on the back of your card and inside your bank's own app. no bank ever asks you to install an app or share your screen.
money already gone? call 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in.

would your parents call the top search result? yes or no.

Comment HELPLINE and I'll DM you the 4 step fake helpline check and a ready message to send your parents.
